outcome: Packed red blood cell (PRBC) transfusion rate
cohort: 260 women with placenta previa (increta or percreta) who underwent pregnancy termination
finding: Planned conservative management using BPAA significantly minimized intraoperative blood loss, the need for B-Lynch suture, and PRBC transfusion in patients with severe placenta accreta spectrum and placenta previa.
